categories.main_business_segments: Coca-Cola Consolidated, Inc. operates primarily through its Nonalcoholic Beverages segment, which accounts for the vast majority of its net sales and income from operations. The company also has two additional operating segments, which are combined into 'All Other' as they do not meet quantitative thresholds for separate reporting. The business is focused on the distribution, marketing, and manufacturing of nonalcoholic beverages, primarily products of The Coca-Cola Company, as well as products from other beverage companies such as Keurig Dr Pepper and Monster Energy.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company manufactures and distributes beverages using bottling and canning technologies, with products packaged primarily in plastic bottles and aluminum cans. It operates 10 manufacturing plants and 60 distribution centers, utilizing advanced supply chain and information technology systems (such as the CONA System) to promote operational efficiency and uniformity. The company participates in national product supply governance and leverages finished goods supply arrangements with other Coca-Cola bottlers, as well as commodity hedging programs for raw materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Coca-Cola Consolidated serves a diverse customer base, including grocery stores, mass merchandise stores, club stores, convenience stores, drug stores, restaurants, schools, amusement parks, recreational facilities, and vending machine outlets. Its largest customers are Wal-Mart Stores, Inc. and The Kroger Company, which together accounted for 32% of total bottle/can sales volume and 26% of total net sales in 2022. The company also serves on-premise locations and other retail channels.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates in territories spanning 14 states and the District of Columbia, serving approximately 60 million consumers. Its five principal markets are the Carolinas, Central, Mid-Atlantic, Mid-South, and Mid-West regions of the United States, with manufacturing and distribution facilities strategically located in key cities within these regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Coca-Cola Consolidated operates primarily as a downstream company in the beverage supply chain, focusing on bottling, packaging, distribution, and direct store delivery of finished beverages to retailers and other end customers. It also has some upstream activities through manufacturing and procurement of raw materials and finished goods supply arrangements with other bottlers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic priorities include commercial execution, revenue management, supply chain optimization, and cash flow generation. It invests in tools and technology to enhance operational efficiency, focuses on optimizing pricing and product mix, and undertakes significant capital expenditures to expand production capabilities and automate operations. Product innovation is driven in collaboration with The Coca-Cola Company and other beverage partners, with recent introductions such as Coca-Cola Creations and fairlife milk products.
categories.revenue_model: Coca-Cola Consolidated generates revenue primarily through the sale of bottled and canned beverages to retail and on-premise customers. Revenue streams include direct product sales, sales to other Coca-Cola bottlers, post-mix sales (fountain syrups), transportation revenue, and equipment maintenance revenue. The company also receives marketing funding support from beverage brand owners, which is accounted for as a reduction in cost of sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company operates in a highly competitive nonalcoholic beverage industry, with principal competitors including local bottlers of PepsiCo, Inc. products and, in some regions, local bottlers of Dr Pepper products, as well as private label beverage producers. Coca-Cola Consolidated is the largest Coca-Cola bottler in the United States and leverages its exclusive distribution rights and strong brand portfolio to maintain a competitive position within its territories.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, Coca-Cola Consolidated reported net sales of $6.2 billion, an 11.5% increase over the prior year, with gross profit of $2.28 billion and net income of $430 million. The company has demonstrated strong cash flow generation, significant capital investment, and a focus on debt reduction. Its growth has been driven by price increases, stable volume, and ongoing supply chain optimization.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Coca-Cola Consolidated emphasizes its role as the largest Coca-Cola bottler in the U.S., offering a broad portfolio of some of the world's most recognized beverage brands. Its value proposition centers on operational excellence, strong customer relationships, exclusive distribution rights, and the ability to deliver high-quality, innovative products efficiently across a large and diverse geographic footprint. The company also highlights its commitment to community engagement and charitable giving as part of its brand differentiation.
